thesis: The episode introduces the story of Rolex, a privately held company founded by Hans Wilsdorf that operates as a paradox by being one of the most secretive and successful luxury brands in the world despite selling millions of units annually. The hosts clarify that the show is not about watches themselves but rather about the business of watches, noting that the company was not founded in Switzerland or by a Swiss person.
